subject: expression: separate `BuildContext` and `EvalContext` (#52311)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent. Core change is `expression.BuildContext` no longer embeds `EvalContext`, adding `GetEvalCtx() EvalContext` instead, with mechanical call-site updates to pass `EvalContext` for evaluation paths while retaining `BuildContext` for build-time needs. Spot-checked high-risk runtime paths (executor join/projection/window/insert, virtual column eval, planner eval/rewrite/plan-cache, constant folding and builtins, mock copr evaluation) and found no SQL semantics, privilege/visibility, session/txn, or concurrency behavior changes beyond interface plumbing. Checked later history on `upstream/master`: context-related refactors continue, but no follow-up fix indicates a correctness regression from this commit.
